description: Real or realistic queries with the passages that should be retrieved, graded by relevance. The fixed test every retrieval change runs against.
Share of the relevant passages found in the top k. Answers "did the right material reach the prompt?"
Mean reciprocal rank: the average of 1 / position of the first relevant result. Rewards putting one good answer near the top.
Normalized discounted cumulative gain: graded relevance discounted by position and divided by the ideal ordering, from 0 to 1.
Share of the top k that is relevant. Matters when irrelevant context is costly or misleading.
Relevance on a scale (for example 0 to 3) instead of yes or no, so a passage that fully answers counts more than a related one.
Retrieval metrics check what reached the prompt; generation metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, citation accuracy) check what the model did with it. Measure both.
